title: zstd and libzstd1 held at the security fix in the PostgreSQL image
note: basis 'shown' means shown by an image built and scanned by the card in a session container (amd64), with the scanner's database downloaded fresh, and by the card's unit test; arm64 was not built.

findings.claim: with today's scanner database the release gates fail trialbox-postgres:16-1 built from master 6c73db64 on CVE-2026-124851 in libzstd1 and zstd 1.5.7+dfsg-1, which stops rehearse step 3 on every head; db.Dockerfile installs exact versions without an upgrade, so the image kept the base's version

the image held at 1.5.7+dfsg-1+deb13u1 (trixie-security, DSA-6657-1) builds on amd64, has both packages installed and held, and passes the gate's scan; arm64 resolves the same version from the suite's index but was not built
nothing runs the release gates against a fresh scanner database on master between trains, so a new advisory on a held package surfaces first as a red train (third time after SC-1b and H-93)
